name: ImGui Window Probe
description: The validation contract's main fixture: native windows with the ids and options its window, lifecycle, input and docking rows name, plus probe actions and a probe_status tool.

tools.name: probe_status
tools.description: What the probe knows about itself: open windows, per-window frames and counters, closes, timer ticks, store keys and the last refusal.

tools.name: probe_run
tools.description: Runs one of the fixture's probe actions by name (reopen, blow_up, open_drag, open_quiet, n_loop, ...), the same actions its menu items run.

action.description: The probe action's name, as README.md lists it.
